summary: Known-object test on TOI-7399.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2458842.6365 (ΔT 72.09 d); 0 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted.
